items.title: Email Campaign · : Concierge "Year 1.5 Math" Campaign
items.preview:
**Audience:** Concierge upsell candidates (13-24 months post-install, not on Concierge). **100 members**
This is your single highest-revenue-per-send opportunity this week. These people already survived their year-1 service, so trust is established, and they're squarely past the 12-month hard floor. At $99/mo, even a 3-4% conversion is meaningful recurring revenue.
**Subject line (primary):**
`The question we get at 18 months`
**Alternates:**
- `Is Concierge actually worth it? The math.` (specific)
- `You're past your first service. Now what?` (curiosity)
- `What your water system needs now (not much)` (pain/relief)
- `A fair breakdown of our $99 plan` (authority/transparency)
**Preview text:**
`No pressure. Just the honest math on whether this makes sense for your home.`
**Body:**
> Hi [First Name],
>
> It's been a little over a year since we installed your ClearWave system, which means you've had your first annual service done and seen how we work.
>
> Around this point, we get the same honest question a lot: "Is the Concierge plan actually worth it for me?"
>
> So here's the straight math, no pressure either way.
>
> Concierge is $99/mo. It covers your annual service, filter swaps, priority phone support, and parts coverage on your standard install components. If you're currently handling things pay-as-you-go, it tends to pencil out once you add up a service visit plus filters plus the occasional part.
>
> If you'd rather keep doing it yourself, that's completely fine. Your system is built to run clean with very little fuss. We just want you to have the numbers.
>
> Want me to run the specific breakdown for your home? Reply to this email and I'll send it over.
>
> Justin
> CEO / ClearWave
**Send timing:** Tuesday, 10:00 AM ET (post-Monday-inbox-clear, mid-morning B2C sweet spot)
**Expected performance:**
- Open: **45-52%** (small, warm, already-serviced segment; well above your 42.3% baseline because these are engaged clients, not the burned broadcast list)
- Click/reply: **4-7%** (reply-driven CTA lowers friction vs. a landing page; this segment has proven trust)
- Conversion: **3-5 new Concierge signups** = $297-$495/mo recurring ($3,564-$5,940 ARR) from a single 100-person send
**Source justification:** Draws from CONCIERGE UPSELL CONTEXT (the "is this worth it at year 1.5" framing, $99/mo feature list, and the "not pushy / here's the math" voice directive) and the Jobber `conciergeUpsellCandidates` trigger (already filtered to 13-24 months, respecting Hard Rule 1).

items.title: Email Campaign · : Referral Push (30-60 Day Post-Install, Satisfied)
items.preview:
**Audience:** Referral push candidates (30-60 days post-install, satisfied). **30 members**
These folks just got clean water and the novelty is still high. This is the peak window for referrals, and the bonus structure gives us a concrete hook. No review ask (ReviewHarvest owns that).
**Subject line (primary):**
`Know someone with rough water?`
**Alternates:**
- `There's $500 in this email for you` (specific)
- `A month in. How's the water?` (curiosity)
- `The thing our best clients do next` (authority)
- `Tired of your neighbor's water complaints?` (pain)
**Preview text:**
`If you send someone our way and they sign on, you get $500. Here's how it works.`
**Body:**
> Hi [First Name],
>
> It's been about a month since we installed your ClearWave system, so you're probably noticing the difference by now (cleaner glasses, softer showers, better coffee).
>
> Quick ask. If you know anyone fighting bad water, friends, family, that neighbor who keeps complaining, send them our way.
>
> Here's how it works:
>
> - They book a free water assessment through you and it closes: you get **$500 cash.** (That climbs to $750 for your 6th through 9th referral in a year, and $1,000 once you hit 10.)
> - They book a consult but don't move forward: you still get a **$50 gift card.**
>
> Just reply with their name and the best way to reach them, or forward them this email. We'll take great care of them.
>
> Justin
> CEO / ClearWave
**Send timing:** Thursday, 11:00 AM ET (end-of-week, higher forwarding behavior before the weekend when people see friends/family)
**Expected performance:**
- Open: **48-55%** (tiny, very fresh, delighted segment; highest engagement window you have)
- Click/reply/forward: **5-9%** (strong cash incentive + low-friction reply/forward CTA)
- Conversion: **1-3 referred consults** over the following 30-45 days; even one closed referral ($500 payout) typically returns a multi-thousand-dollar install
**Source justification:** Draws from Hard Rule 3 (push referrals, never reviews), Hard Rule 3a (exact phrase "free water assessment"), the REFERRAL BONUS STRUCTURE (exact tiered numbers), and the Jobber `referralPushCandidates` trigger (30-60 days, satisfied). All four candidate systems here are "(not specified)" or legacy, so I used the tenure line throughout per Hard Rule 2.
---
### Why not the others this week
- **1-year annual service (20):** Worth running, but it's operational/scheduling, not top-conversion revenue, and I don't want to crowd the same inboxes. Queue for next week.
- **Cold lead re-engagement (1,000):** High potential but needs a fresh water-news angle sourced before send, and blasting 1,000 cold contacts while your deliverability is already soft risks further reputation damage. Let's do the two warm, high-intent sends first, then re-engage cold with a proper value-led piece next week.
Want me to build the 1-year service and cold re-engagement drafts for next week?
